items.title: 杏一網站疑似發生個資外洩
items.summary: 10月7日醫療用品零售通路公司杏一（4175）於夜間在股市公開資訊觀測站發布重大訊息，該公司接獲少數消費者反映，由委外廠商管理的網站平臺，疑似有第三方不當取得資料，並透過電子郵件聯繫消費者。對此杏一啟動資安事件應變機制，責成網站維護廠商進行調查，並透過網站與App向消費者加強反詐騙宣導。

items.title: ChatGPT回答不只文字，GPT-6開始動態組合互動介面
items.summary: OpenAI在ChatGPT加入智慧介面（Intelligent UI），GPT-6可依問題內容，把文字、圖片、圖表、按鈕及表單組成可直接操作的回應。使用者也能要求ChatGPT建立計算機、分帳工具或簡單遊戲，直接在對話中使用，不再只有文字回答。OpenAI在9月已先後推出GPT-6 Sol、Luna及GPT-6.1 Sol，在ChatGPT產品中先提供於Work與Codex，這次更新則把GPT-6帶進一般ChatGPT聊天介面。

items.title: test(process): select broker coverage by transport support (#166858)
items.summary: test(process): select broker coverage by transport support (#166858) Copied runtime exclusions hid compatible Bun broker coverage. Share the product command-transport selector with its tests and enable the portable lifecycle/resource suites while preserving Node-only transferable pipes and Linux Gateway selection. Verified on Linux with Node 24.19 (90 passing cases) and pinned Bun fc53 (21 passing, 69 intentional transport-selection skips), scoped changed checks, independent P2 review, exact-head CI, and ClawSweeper. Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger

items.title: fix(gateway): bound unattributable proxy warnings per source (#134404)
items.summary: fix(gateway): bound unattributable proxy warnings per source (#134404) Replace the lifetime one-shot latch on unattributable trusted-proxy warnings with a bounded per-source budget (32-entry cache, five-minute TTL, 16 warnings per window), so new sources are still reported while one noisy source cannot flood the log. Request handling and auth decisions are unchanged. Fixes #134297. Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
